text:
Neha Bari.
    

    
      SUMMARY
      EXPERIENCE

          Hi, I am Neha! Welcome. My spirit cartoon is Bugs Bunny,
          and on this website I want to show my projects and side hobbies.
        

        
          
            EXPLORE MY WORK ↘
          
          
            SAY HI TO BUNNY ↗
          
        
      

      
        
        
        
          Eh… what’s up, doc?
        
      
    

    
      01 / SUMMARY

      
        A littleabout me.

        
          
            I’m Neha Bari Tamboli. My experience includes industry
            projects with TU Eindhoven, Philips, and Enexis.
          
          
            I work with Python, SQL, PySpark, Azure Databricks,
            and Delta Lake, across data processing, forecasting,
            and machine learning.
          
          
            I enjoy translating stakeholder needs into technical
            solutions and building reliable datasets that support
            useful decisions.
          
        
      
    

    
      
        
          
            02 / PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
          
          Professional Experience.
        
      

      
        
          
            TU EINDHOVEN · 2025–2026
          
          Restaurant Digitalization
          
            Gathered input from four restaurants and 65 customers,
            translating the findings into 35 prioritized requirements
            for an AI ordering assistant.
          
          
            Built a scheduled Databricks workflow to validate
            221 simulated customer sessions and stored validated
            data in Delta Lake.
          
          
            Analyzed ordering interface variants with SQL and developed
            Logistic Regression and XGBoost models for order completion,
            achieving approximately 0.79 ROC AUC.
          
          
            PYTHON · SQL · DATABRICKS · DELTA LAKE
          
        

        
          
            PHILIPS · 2024–2025
          
          Digital Pathology
          
            Managed an Agile project exploring intelligent assignment
            of pathology cases, working with Philips’ Pathology team.
          
          
            Assessed database schemas and documented six high-priority
            and five medium-priority data quality gaps.
          
          
            Aligned open-source data with Philips’ schema and explained
            the implications of data gaps to nontechnical stakeholders.
          
          
            DATA QUALITY · DATA MODELING · AGILE
          
        

        
          
            ENEXIS · 2024
          
          Electricity Forecasting
          
            Developed PySpark workflows in Azure Databricks to prepare
            electricity load records for forecasting.
          
          
            Created lag, rolling average, and calendar features.
            The processing workflow ran in 1 minute and 2 seconds
            in the development environment.
          
          
            Used chronological training for a GRU forecasting model,
            achieving 7.63% MAPE.
          
          
            PYSPARK · DATABRICKS · GRU
          
        

        
          
            INNO4HEALTH · 2024
          
          AFib Detection on ECG
          
            Processed ECG recordings into 30-second windows and
            identified 21 features relevant to AFib detection.
          
          
            Worked in a five-person Agile team, sharing findings
            with stakeholders during weekly reviews.
          
          
            ECG ANALYSIS · FEATURE EXTRACTION
          
        

        
          
            KNSB · ALLIANDER · OMRON · 2024
          
          Industry Collaborations
          
            Omron: Analyzed 42 machine sensor
            signals for equipment fault indicators.
          
          
            Alliander: Grouped 30,000 customer
            records into eight load-profile segments.
          
          
            KNSB: Led a team analyzing over
            500,000 skating records to compare engagement.
          
          
            DATA ANALYSIS · CLUSTERING · TEAM LEADERSHIP
          
        

        
          
            TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES · 2016–2018
          
          Software Developer
          
            For client Morgan Stanley, supported production batch
            job migrations across regions.
          
          
            Monitored execution against SLA windows and reported
            failed or delayed runs.
          
          
            BATCH OPERATIONS · PRODUCTION SUPPORT
          
        
      
    

    
      
        
          03 / SKILLS
          My skills.
        
      

      
        
          01
          Programming
          Python
          SQL
          PySpark
        

        
          02
          Data Engineering
          
            Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, ETL pipelines,
            data transformation, and data modeling.
          
          
            Azure DevOps, GitHub, CI/CD, and model monitoring.
          
        

        
          03
          AI & Machine Learning
          XGBoost · GRU · LSTM
          
            COLLABORATION · AGILE / SCRUM
          
        
      
    

    
      04 / LANGUAGES

      
        Languages
        
          English · Hindi · Marathi
          Dutch — A1/A2
        
      
    

    
      
        
          05 / EDUCATION
          My education.
        
      

      
        
          
            TU EINDHOVEN · 2024–2026
          
          EngD Data Science
          
            Industry-focused data science program (contract),
            combining research and practical challenges.
          
        

        
          
            UNIVERSITY OF GRONINGEN · 2018–2021
          
          M.Sc. Computing Science
          
            Research in neural networks and neuroimaging.
          
        

        
          
            SAVITRIBAI PHULE PUNE UNIVERSITY · 2011–2015
          
          B.E. Computer Engineering
          
            Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering.
          
        

      
        
          UNIVERSITY OF GRONINGEN · 2021
        
        M.Sc. Thesis
        Relevance Learning in Neuroimaging
          
            Integrated FDG PET data from three hospitals into
            a consistent dataset and corrected hospital-specific bias.
          
          
            Extended and evaluated a neural network classifier
            on 175 cases, achieving approximately 85% AUROC,
            and assessed feature relevance.
          
          
            NEURAL NETWORKS · NEUROIMAGING
          
        

      
        
          UNIVERSITY OF GRONINGEN · 2020
        
        M.Sc. Research Internship
        Hidden Unit Specialization
          
            Investigated how dataset size and activation functions
            affected neural network generalization and hidden
            unit specialization.
          
          
            NEURAL NETWORKS · RELU · SIGMOID
          
        
      
    

    
      
        
          
            06 / TRAINING & HACKATHONS
          
          Training & Hackathons.
        
      

      
        
          
            TU EINDHOVEN · APRIL 2025
          
          Spring HPC School
          
            Completed training at the Eindhoven Supercomputing Center.
          
        

        
          
            TU EINDHOVEN / JADS · APRIL 2024
          
          Solve with Google Hackathon
          Participated as a member of Team 3.
